name: 64130 · Kansas City, MO
findings: ZIP 64130 (Kansas City) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64130 (Kansas City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 64130 (Kansas City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
